༄༅/ /tshogs gsog cing dkor sgrib sbyong byed gaṅgā'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /tshogs gsog cing dkor sgrib sbyong byed gaṅgā'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo shākya mu na ye/ 'dir tshogs gsog pa dang dad rdzas sogs kyi dkor sgrib sbyong ba'i thabs gsag sbyang gi gnad bsdus pa ji ltar bya ba ni/ spyir tshogs zhing gang la brten pa de'i drung du byas kyang rung mod/ dmigs phugs pa'i go rims legs par bsgrigs te byas na legs pas de'i tshul ni/ mchog gsum rgyal ba sras bcas byin rlabs dang*/ /chos nyid rnam dag rten 'brel bden pa'i mthus/ /gnas 'di bde ldan zhing ltar snod bcud kyi/ / 'byor ldan mchod tshogs rgya mtshos khyab gyur cig /der ni pad+ma 'dab ma stong ldan dbus/ /rab mdzes seṅge'i khri steng zla ba'i gdan/ /mtha' skor khor yug 'dab ma rgyas pa'i steng*/ /grangs med zla ba'i gdan gyis mdzes gyur cig / ces bden pa'i byin brlab/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*/ / zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig dang*/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing nas rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*/ /yi dam lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems dang*/ /nyan rang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bstan srung bcas/ /'dir gshegs rang rang gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /zhes pas spyan drangs te bzhugs pa'i mos pa shugs can bya/ de nas dang po phyag 'tshal ba ni/ rgyal ba kun gyi 'phrin las gcig bsdus shing*/ /dam chos ma lus 'byung ba'i sgo gcig pu/ /dngos grub rtsa ba drin can bla ma dang*/ /rdo rje 'chang chen dbyer med gus phyag 'tshal/ /thugs bskyed snying stobs brtson 'grus mchog gis ni/ /snyigs dus 'gro la lhag par rjes su brtse/ /bde gshegs gzhan las thugs rje ches dpa' ba/ /thub dbang smra ba'i dam par gus phyag 'tshal/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab mi pham chos kyi rje/ /mkhyen rab dbang phyug rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /shing rta chen po klu sgrub thogs med zhabs/ /zla med skyabs gyur rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun mkhyen gnyis par cher grags dbyig gnyen zhabs/ /'phags grol mchog gi sde dang dul ba'i

sde/ /seng bzang gser gling ba dang a ti sha /rgya chen spyod pa'i brgyud la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa lha dang zla grags zhi ba lha/ /rigs pa'i khu byug 'brom ston pu to ba/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa sogs/ /zab mo lta ba'i brgyud la=/ /in+d+ra bho dhi sa ra ha ba dang*/ /lū hi dril bu pa dang nag po spyod/ /te lo na ro la li ta la sogs/ /grub chen bla ma rnams la=/ /kun snying sangs rgyas gsang ba shākya bshes/ /phyogs glang chos grags shan+ti a bha ya/ /zhi 'tsho pad+ma'i ngang tshul sgeg rdor sogs/ /'phags yul paṇa chen rnams=/ /sa paṇa bu ston re mda' dbu ma ba/ /lho brag grub chen 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i dpal/ /rgyal tshab mkhas grub 'dul 'dzin dge 'dun grub/ /nor bzang rgya mtsho'i zhabs la=/ /thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dpal/ /mdo rgyud kun mkhyen paṇa chen bsod nams grags/ /rigs pa'i dbang phyug rje btsun bstan dar sogs/ /bod yul bla ma rnams=/ /khyad par paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan rje/ /ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho'i dpal/ /mchog sprul 'gro mgon blo bzang ye shes zhabs/ /rje btsun bskal bzang rgya mtshor=/ /gang las mdo rgyud dbang lung man ngag gi /cha shas phra mo yan chad ci zhig kyang*/ /bka' drin mnos pa'i bshes gnyen dam pa sogs/ /drin can bla ma rnams=/ /snyigs 'gror rjes brtse rgyal ba sman gyi bla/ /mngon dga'i zhing gi 'dren pa mi 'khrugs pa/ /bde ldan mgon po snang mtha' tshe dpag med/ /kun gzigs chen po'i zhabs la=/ /rnam snang la sogs rgyal ba rigs lnga dang*/ /rnam gzigs la sogs sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun/ /mtshan legs yongs bsgrags la sogs bde gshegs brgyad/ /bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong la=/ /shaka thub la sogs bde gshegs so lnga dang*/ /nyi zla mar me gsal dang mar me mdzad/ / 'od mi 'gyur dang kun dpal rnam bkod sogs/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams=/

/mdo sde dbyangs bsnyad lung bstan tshigs su bcad/ /ched brjod gleng gzhi rtogs brjod 'das pa brjod/ /skyes rab shin rgyas rmad byung gtan phab sde'i/ /yan lag bcu gnyis gsung la=/ /'dul mngon mdo sde pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung*/ /bya spyod yo ga rnal 'byor bla med rgyud/ /gang gi dgongs 'grel legs bshad chos kyi tshul/ /lung gi dam chos rnams=/ /bslab gsum nges 'byung byang sems yang dag lta/ /phyin drug sa bcu lam lnga rim gnyis sogs/ /grol byed lam dang grol ba'i 'gog pa ste/ /rtogs pa'i dam chos rnams=/ /byams pa 'jam dbyangs phyag rdor spyan ras gzigs/ /sa snying sgrib sel nam snying kun tu bzang*/ /blo gros mi bzad spobs brtsegs nam mkha' mdzod/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la=/ /gdung sel snang ba brtsegs sogs rang rgyal dang*/ /'od srung rab 'byor la sogs nyan thos brgyad/ /yan lag 'byung sogs gnas brtan bcu drug bcas/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la=/ /dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa 'khor lo sdom/ /dgyes rdor dus kyi 'khor lo gshin rje gshed/ /rdor dbyings kun rig la sogs rgyud sde bzhi'i/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams=/ /gdugs dkar sgrol ma rnam rgyal dbyangs can ma/ /seng gdong ri khrod ma dang 'od zer can/ /ral gcig tsun+da mkha' 'gro sde lnga sogs/ /zhi khro lha mo'i tshogs la=/ /ye shes bcu yi bdag nyid las byung zhing*/ /phyogs mtshams gdon bgegs tshar gcod 'jigs tshul can/ /hūṃ mdzad 'khor bsgyur gshin rje gshed la sogs/ /stobs chen khro rgyal rnams la=/ /ye shes mgon po phyag drug phyag bzhi ba/ /zhal bzhi gur mgon bram gzugs chos kyi rgyal/ /dmar zor rgyal mo rnam sras beg rtse sogs/ / chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la=/ /phyag byar 'os pa zhes sogs kyis phyag 'tshal/ gnyis pa mchod pa ni/ slu med skyabs kyi dam pa khyed rnams la=/

/ma lus zhing gi mchod yon zhabs bsil dang*/ /me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab dang*/ / zhal zas rol mo 'dod yon tshogs rnams 'bul/ /'khor lo nor bu btsun mo blon po dang*/ /glang chen rta mchog dmag dpon rin chen bdun/ /gdugs dang gser nya gter bum pad+ma dung*/ /dpal be'u rgyal mtshan 'khor lo rnams kyang 'bul/ khrus rdzing gos dang rin chen gzhal med khang*/ /bla re ba dan dbu rgyan bstod dbyangs sgra/ /gling bzhi nyi zla ri rab stong gsum sogs/ /bdag lus longs spyod dge tshogs bcas te 'bul/ /gang dag bdag la re zhing bltos pa yis/ /bza' btung gos dang rin chen rigs la sogs/ /bsngos shing sbyin pa byung dang 'byung 'gyur rnams/ /'bul lo mchod do bzhes nas byin gyis rlobs/ /ji ltar kun bzang 'jam dbyangs la sogs pas/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba mchod pas mnyes mdzad pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis mchod pa'i tshogs kun gyis/ /skyabs gnas dam pa 'khor bcas mchod par bgyi/ /gsum pa bshags pa ni/ bdag gzhan thog ma med nas da lta'i bar/ /mi dge bcu dang mtshams med nye ba lnga/ /bslab bya rnams dang 'gal bar gyur ba yi/ /bcas rang sdig ltung thams cad so sor bshags/ /gang gis bdag la zas sbyin skom blud dang*/ /mkho ba'i yo byad la sogs dngos kun gyis/ /mchod cing bsnyen bkur byed dang byed 'gyur de'i/ /sdig sgrib thams cad bshags so byang bar mdzod/ /yan lag lhag ma ni/ rang gzhan skye 'phags kun gyi rnam dkar la/ /bsam pa dag pas rjes su yi rang zhing*/ /rgyal sras nyan rang 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams la/ /chos kyi 'khor lo dam pa bskor bar bskul/ /gang dag mya ngan 'da' tshul ston bzhed kun/ /de dag mya ngan mi 'da' rtag bzhugs gsol/ /'di ltar bgyis pa'i dge mtshon dus gsum gyi/ /rnam dkar ji snyed bsags bsdoms thams cad kyang*/ /bdag dang pha mar gyur ba'i 'gro ba rnams/ /ngan song las grol rdzogs byang thob phyir bsngo/

/bla ma dkon mchog gsum dang yi dam lha/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bstan srung rgya mtshor bcas/ / skyabs mgon dam pa 'khor bcas khyed rnams la/ /gus pas skyabs mchi rtse gcig gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs rje che ldan skyabs mchog khyed rnams kyis/ / bdag dang bdag la re bltos 'cha' byed pa'i/ /'gro rnams ngan song 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las/ /myur drongs rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob byin rlabs/ / phyi ma 'di lan gsum sogs byas kyang legs shing*/ de ltar gsol bas tshogs zhing thams cad las/ /'od dang bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung rang bzhin gyi/ /spyi bo nas zhugs nyes pa'i tshogs sbyang nas/ /'od zhu rang la thim pas byin rlabs gyur/ / zhes bya'o/ /bsdu na/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*/ /zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig dang*/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*/ /zhes sogs tshigs su bcad pa gcig gi mthar/ /bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs/ / zhes sogs tshig bcad gcig brjod/ /lhar bcas 'gro ba'i ston pa zas gtsang sras/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab dam pa mi pham mgon/ /mkhyen pa'i gter gyur rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /sangs rgyas byang sems gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ / klu sgrub ār+ya de ba sogs dang*/ zab mo lta ba'i brgyud sogs dang*/ rab 'byor gsung rabs sogs dang*/ phyogs bcu'i 'gro la= //= = =// mtshan legs rin chen= //= = =// sangs rgyas rnam gzigs= //= = =// mthun pa'i smon lam= //= = =// kun 'byung mun pa'i= //= = =// 'jam dbyangs phyag na rdo rje= //= = =// spang dang ye shes= //= = =// dpal ldan dus 'khor= //= = =// sgrub pa po la= //= = =// ye shes mgon po= //= = =// ston pa sangs rgyas= //= = =// rtsa brgyud bla ma= //= = =// mgon po thugs rje sogs sh+lau ka bzhi brjod/ ji snyed su dag nas bdag gis bstod/ /ces pa'i bar dang*/ phyag byar 'os pa sogs ci rigs kyis phyag bya'o/ /de nas me tog dam pa nas phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi/

/zhes pa'i bar dang*/ sa gzhi spos kyi sogs dang*/ bdag gzhan lus ngag sogs brjod/ bsdu na mchod pa 'dis chog /rgyas par 'dod na/ khyad par du/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams dang/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang*/ dam pa'i chos rnams dang*/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad la phyag 'tshal zhing mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /lan gsum mam ci rigs/ khyed rnams la bdag pos bzung ba dang ma bzung ba'i lha dang mi'i yo byad phun sum tshogs pa ji snyed mchis pa rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bsod nams dang rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs las byung ba'i yo byad thams cad dang*/ kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad 'bul zhing mchod do/ /'di yang gcig gam gsum sogs ci rigs brjod/ khyad par du yang su zhig bdag la bltos bcas kyi sgo nas bsngos pa'i zas gos sogs ji snyed mchis pa thams cad dang bdag gi lus longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams kyang legs par 'bul lo/ /bzhes su gsol lo/ /bzhes nas kyang bdag dang dmigs yul du gyur ba'i sems can thams cad kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa lan bdun nam nyer gcig brjod la/ bdag dang sems can de dag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes pa'i tshogs ji snyed cig mchis pa thams cad mthol lo/ /bshags so/ /gnong ngo*/ /'gyod do/ /byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ byang zhing dag par gyur cig /ces ci rigs brjod/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan rang 'phags pa rnams kyi bsod nams kyi phung bo dang*/ mdzad pa phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang*/ bdag dang sems can gzhan dag gis kyang bsags pa'i rnam dkar gyi legs tshogs thams cad la yang rjes su yi rang zhing dga' bar bgyi'o/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med pa bskor bar bskul lo/

/de dag thams cad kyang mya ngan las mi 'da' bar rtag par bzhugs su gsol/ 'di ltar bgyis pa'i rnam dkar gyi phung bo kun dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge tshogs dang lhan cig tu/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir bsngo bar bgyi'o/ /de nas phyag 'tshal ba dang zhes sogs kyis mjug bsdu ba'am/ cung zad rgyas par na/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs so/ /ci rigs brjod/ dmigs bsal yod na khyad par du lha mchog 'di zhes bgyi ba 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhes sbyar rung*/ de nas khyed rnams kyis bdag sogs sems can thams cad dang*/ khyad par du bdag la mos pa'i dbang gis re ltos 'cha' ba'i sems can thams cad 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal mtha' dag las yongs su skyob du gsol/ thar bar mdzad du gsol/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub rdzogs par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan mang du gsol ba btab pa la brten nas/ mthar skyabs gnas de rnams kyi sku las 'od dang bdud rtsi'i tshogs dpag tu med pa byung nas bdag dang sems can de rnams kyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag song snyam pa'i mos pa bya'o/ /de ltar yang yang byas na rang gzhan gnyis ka'i tshogs rdzogs shing sgrib pa sbyong ba dang*/ khyad par du gang la dmigs pa de la yang phan nges shing snying rje chen po skye ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba dang*/ dkor sgrib thams cad sbyong bar yang nus so/ /der ma zad skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa sogs dang*/ shes rab gong 'phel du 'gyur ba sogs sa lam gyi yon tan rgyud la skye ba ni/ rten gyi drung du tshogs sogs sgrib sbyong byed pa la rags las pa yin te/ lam rim chen mo las/ lam rgyud la skye ba'i mthun rkyen tshogs bsags pa dang 'gal rkyen sgrib pa sbyong ba'i lhan cig byed rkyen med na nyer len gyi rgyu dmigs rnams sbyong ba tsam la 'bad kyang lam shin tu skye dka' bas bsag sbyang gi gnad bsdus pa'i yan lag bdun pas rgyud sbyong dgos so zhes pa dang*/

yang rjes lam rim las/ de ltar zhing dam pa la dge rtsa bskrun pa'i mthu las lam gyi rim pa rnams la blo'i mthu je rgyas su 'gro bas/ mnyan na tshig mi zin/ bsam na don mi go /bsgom na rgyud la mi skye ba'i blo'i mthu chung ba'i dus su zhing gi mthu la brten pa man ngag yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas so// //ces pa 'di ni dad dang rnam dpyod phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas brtan bzod pa'i ming can gyis 'di ltar bgyis shig dang khos par du sgrub par bya'o zhes bskul ba la brten nas bshad sgrub ming can gyis re gnyis la phan srid snyam pa'i bsam pas sbyar ba'o/ /bkra shis// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/tshogs gsog cing dkor sgrib sbyong byed gaṅgā'i chu rgyun bzhugs/ - PAGE 224-- PAGE 223-- PAGE 216-
